links.comparator_used: AI-generated medical advice shown without a disclaimer (study 1: standard chatbot disclaimer; study 2: stronger disclaimer highlighting higher error risk than physicians, with required confirmation of reading)
links.outcome: Lay participants' ratings of the advice's empathy, reliability and comprehensibility, and their willingness to follow it
links.effect: Study 1: disclaimer did not significantly affect any outcome (all p > .17). Study 2: no significant effect on empathy, reliability or comprehensibility (all p > .19); willingness to follow was slightly lower with the disclaimer (p = .039), but this did not remain significant after correction for multiple testing. No significant difference between the two disclaimers.
links.quote: In study 1, the disclaimer did not significantly affect any outcome (all p > .17).
